findings.evidence:
SVG has a labeled rect node data-id for state 'Idle' with text

Idle

at that position, but asciiText shows five blank lines (' ') where case-000's correct rendering of the same source/SVG shows '\u256d\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u256e' / '\u2502 Idle \u2502' / '\u2570\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u256f'.

findings.summary: The arrowhead on the edge from the start marker into the Idle box is missing.
findings.evidence: edge0's path in the SVG ends with marker-end pointing into the Idle box, but asciiText has no '\u25bc' glyph on the line above '\u256d\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u256e', unlike case-000's identical source/SVG which renders '\u25bc' there.

findings.summary: Every transition arrowhead in the diagram points the wrong direction (reversed), misrepresenting the state machine's flow.
findings.evidence: All edge paths in the SVG run top-to-bottom (e.g. edge0 'M54.957,22L...L54.957,72', edge3 'M54.957,226L...L54.957,300'), meaning arrows should point down ('\u25bc'), and case-000's correct rendering of the identical source/SVG shows '\u25bc' at the top, by the complete->Done edge, and at the bottom end-marker, with '\u25b2' only on the upward cancel edge. case-003's asciiText instead shows '\u25b2' at the top, by complete, and at the bottom, and '\u25bc' on the cancel edge (swapped with start) — every arrowhead is inverted from the ground truth.
